title: The Covariant Riesz Transforms on Riemannian Manifolds
summary: We establish the $L^p$-boundedness of the local covariant Riesz transform for differential forms on manifold $M$ with bounded $\|Rm\|$. Let $Δ_j$ be the Hodge Laplace operator on $j$-forms. For any $p \in (1, \infty)$ and $κ>κ_0$, we show that the operator $\nabla (Δ_j + κ)^{-1/2}$ is bounded on $L^p(M)$. Consequently, we obtain Calderón-Zygmund estimates for manifolds with bounded Riemannian curvature.
